title.zh: 复盘：问清一个标签，也约好何时收尾
title.en: Review one label and a stopping point

paragraphs.zh: 沿用纸趣物的幻想标签，分别圈出可观察的描述和小组添写的故事，再约一个真正需要回答的问题。若目的只是营造虚构气氛，可以保留未知，不必把所有模糊都查到底。只改自编标签即可。复盘看区分是否帮助玩法、答案是否已够用，不用不断追问证明聪明，也不据此审视真人动机。
paragraphs.en: For the paper curiosity’s fanciful label, mark visible description separately from the group’s invented story, then agree one question worth answering. Fictional atmosphere may leave things unknown without investigating every ambiguity. Revise a self-made label only. Review a useful distinction and a sufficient answer rather than proving intelligence through repeated questioning or scrutinising real people’s motives.

title.zh: 借原创纸趣物活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original paper-curiosity activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果纸趣物标签混着观察和幻想，你会先问哪一个问题，又在什么答案出现后愿意收尾？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a paper curiosity label mixed observation and fantasy, which question would you ask and what answer would let you finish?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making objects, attending or disclosing experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享公开说明，链接不含答案或计数。六个名字只对应本版选项，不测诊断、智力、情绪能力、危险性或超能力。对方可不了解作品、换角色、不同意、不回答或结束；不从风格或身体表现推断私人身份，也不替缺席者贴标签。

Six names concern this edition’s options, assessing no diagnosis, intelligence, emotional capacity, dangerousness or powers. The other person may be unfamiliar with the story, change characters, disagree, decline or stop. Infer no private identity from style or physical performance and label no absent person.

title.zh: 复盘：欢迎不要求对方先变得热情
title.en: Review a welcome without requiring enthusiasm

paragraphs.zh: 沿用停在柜旁的访客，写一句能动手、只看或稍后再来的邀请，再让安静回应也有下一步。提示可以多彩，也可以用简单文字；不必替别人判断该开心。可以只写卡片。复盘看选择是否清楚、自己的投入是否自愿，不把开口多少或笑容当归属证据，也不要求你永久做快乐主持者。
paragraphs.en: For the visitor beside the cabinet, offer trying, watching or returning later, with a usable next step even after a quiet response. Colourful cues or plain text can work without deciding how someone should feel. Write a card only. Review clear choices and voluntary effort without treating talk or smiles as belonging, or assigning you permanent cheerful hosting.

title.zh: 借原创纸趣物活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original paper-curiosity activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果访客停在柜旁不说话，你会怎样邀请动手或只看，又不要求对方解释心情？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a visitor stood quietly beside the cabinet, how would you offer trying or watching without asking them to explain their mood?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making objects, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：公平先落在信息与选择上
title.en: Review fairness through information and choices

paragraphs.zh: 沿用制作者熟悉、访客陌生的观察挑战，先让双方拿到同一份起始说明，给练习回合，再明确不计胜负的版本。若仍有人不想参加，可以直接看展。只改规则卡也行。复盘看规则是否明白、参与是否自愿，不把输赢当领导才能或人的地位，也不默认一套规则对所有人都已合适。
paragraphs.en: For the observation challenge familiar to makers but new to visitors, provide the same starting instructions, a practice turn and an unscored version. Anyone may simply view the display. Revise a rule card only. Review understanding and voluntary participation without treating wins as leadership or status, or assuming one arrangement already fits everyone.

title.zh: 借原创纸趣物活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original paper-curiosity activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果制作者比访客更熟悉观察挑战，你会改哪一项起始信息，并留下什么不计胜负的玩法？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If makers knew an observation challenge better than visitors, which starting information would you change and what unscored version would you offer?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making objects, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：看见纹路，不急着给原因
title.en: Review a visible pattern without rushing to a cause

paragraphs.zh: 沿用允许查看的叶片照片，记三处线条、形状或颜色，再给尚不清楚的原因写“未知”。伙伴可补一项不同观察，不必找稀有物种或采集活物。可以只看照片。复盘关注描述是否来自画面，不以记录多少评科学天分、注意力或爱自然程度；有趣也不需要宏大解释。
paragraphs.en: For a leaf photograph you may view, note three lines, shapes or colours and mark an uncertain cause as unknown. A partner can add a different observation without rare-species searches or collecting living things. View only if preferred. Review descriptions grounded in the image without grading scientific talent, attention or care for nature through note counts. Interest needs no grand explanation.

title.zh: 借原创纸趣物活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original paper-curiosity activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只看一张普通叶片照片，你会记哪三个可见细节，又把什么暂时留作未知？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Looking at an ordinary leaf photograph, which three visible details would you note and what would remain unknown?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making objects, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：视觉连贯也容得下一件不同
title.en: Review continuity with one contrasting piece

paragraphs.zh: 沿用不再添购物件的小收藏，重复一个形状或留白方式，再把一件不同作品并排保留。问制作者与访客哪种更好找、更愿意看，而非先定某种美学高级。可以只画摆放图。复盘看风格是否服务使用与乐趣，不用一致程度评阶层、优雅或成熟，也不要求别人放弃个人偏好来维持气氛。
paragraphs.en: For the collection using existing pieces, repeat a shape or spacing pattern and keep a contrasting work beside it. Ask makers and visitors what is easier to find or more enjoyable, without declaring an aesthetic superior. Sketch the arrangement only. Review use and enjoyment without grading class, elegance or maturity through uniformity or requiring abandoned preferences to preserve atmosphere.

title.zh: 借原创纸趣物活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original paper-curiosity activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果用现有纸作品做一个连贯陈列，你会重复哪种视觉特征，又刻意保留哪一处不同？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For a coherent display of existing paper pieces, which visual feature would you repeat and which difference would you retain?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making objects, attending or disclosing experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：先选帮助形式，再约完成点
title.en: Review the form of help and its finish

paragraphs.zh: 沿用折纸隔层，先问需要演示、图解还是短文字，再经同意处理物件或只指示一步。使用者可纠正说明、用辅助方式尝试或不试，做完约定部分就停。可以只构思提示。复盘看动作是否更好理解，不比较身体、说话或灵巧，也不把帮助当服从、欠下的服务或永久辅助分工。
paragraphs.en: For the folded compartment, ask about a demonstration, diagram or short text before handling the object with permission or indicating one step. The user may correct instructions, use assistance or decline, and help ends at the agreed check. Imagine a cue only. Review understanding without comparing bodies, speech or dexterity, or treating help as obedience, owed service or a permanent support role.

title.zh: 借原创纸趣物活动聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original paper-curiosity activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一个折纸隔层说不清，你会先怎样选择演示、图解或文字，再约清只帮哪一步？”各拟一种做法，再借另一位角色的角度修改。可只想象，不必制作、参加活动或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a folded compartment was hard to explain, how would you choose a demonstration, diagram or text and agree the single step to clarify?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making objects, attending or disclosing experiences.
